## Triage: first touch — `enhancement` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:reports` · `needs-user-decision` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-25T14:57Z

⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Triage leaning: B,** a time range plus export. Both reuse what exists: the dashboard's `dateRange` and the list-export permission. That answers the two questions a manager asks first, at spec S + objectui M+S.
- **Not C yet:** a subscription is a new scheduled-work surface, and scheduled work is off on Free plans (objectstack-ai/objectstack#25442). It should be a card of its own when a customer asks.
- **D** leaves every all-time report unable to say which period it covers.
- A time-range key on reports is a protocol addition; its spec half is filed in objectstack once the letter is chosen.

Brief-claimed-by: session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb · batch #392 · 2026-10-26T04:13Z

Director seat, summon #51 (ledger objectstack#12708). This card is presented to the maintainer in batch #392 as item 4 of 5. Seat increment (what was re-verified before presenting; the card's own analysis is not restated):
- Spec at `origin/main`: `packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts` has `runtimeFilter` (dataset-bound scope filter, line 326) and no `dateRange`, export or subscription key; `dashboard.zod.ts` carries the built-in `dateRange` with `DATE_RANGE_PRESETS` (lines 1409–1541). ADR-0021:392 already plans the report schema refactor onto the dataset grammar — so a report `dateRange` would ride a planned shape, not a new one.
- `git grep -iE 'report.*(dateRange|export|subscri)'` on AGENTS.md + docs/adr + packages/spec/src → ADR-0021 (report = pivot grid with export; dashboard globalFilters/dateRange → dimension names) and the 18.x semantic entries on the closed dateRange vocabulary; nothing rules on a report time range or subscription.
- Facets read: same direction; the seat agrees with **B** (time range + export, both reusing existing surfaces; subscription waits for measured pull). After the letter: the spec half is filed first (objectstack, `domain:spec`), then the `ui/` renderer card — the card now lives here after the objectui transfer.

Ruling: batch #392 item 4 · letter B · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-26T04:56Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708, brief 6408063451). Letter **B**: a shipped report gets a time range — reusing the dashboard's `dateRange` vocabulary and presets, applied when the dataset has a time dimension — and export of the report table (CSV / XLSX through the existing list-export permission). No subscription now: C becomes a card of its own only when a customer asks, and scheduled work is off on Free plans (#25442). Not A (export is a near-zero addition on the same surfaces) and not D (an all-time report that cannot say which period it covers stays a dashboard appendix).

Workload of the chosen letter (card column): spec S + ui M (time range) + ui S (export; list export already exists).

Execution: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in this act (`domain:ui`, p2, `area:reports`). Order: the claiming seat first files the spec card in this repository (`domain:spec`: report `dateRange` riding the dataset grammar ADR-0021 line 392 already plans, plus an export flag; `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`) and puts `Blocked-by:` on this card until that lands; this card is then the `ui/` renderer work (Console report page: date-range chip + export control). HotCRM declares the range on its ten reports once released. Claims and dispatches carry `Ruling-ref:` naming this comment.

Blocked-by: #26548
Ruling-ref: 6408567749
Seat: `domain:ui#2` · `session_01SMps7wq7rBTk53e8KTSEup` · `os-steve` · 2026-10-27T07:38Z

Executing ruling B's order: the spec prerequisite is filed as #26548 (`domain:spec`, p2: report `dateRange` bound to a dataset `type: 'date'` dimension, and `exportOptions` reusing the list's export members and the `allowExport` axis). This card moves `pm:queue` → `pm:blocked` until #26548 lands, then it is the `ui/` renderer work (Console report page: date-range chip + export control). ⛔ Not a claim; no slot is held.

Two points #26548 leaves to its review, both of which shape this card's renderer work:
- the key that names the date column: #26548 proposes `dimension` (ADR-0021's dimension-name grammar) with `field` as a rename hint, where the dashboard's own `dateRange.field` is a raw object field;
- XLSX: the list's XLSX goes only through the server record stream (`GET /data/:object/export`), which cannot carry aggregated report rows, so report XLSX would be written in the browser (`exceljs` is already a ui dependency) and `allowExport` would gate the control, not the data.
